title: hsm-bridge-rotator-and-sealedsecret-fallback-orchestration
author: Diego Morales
description: Motivation: On customer on-prem migrations we frequently see multi-step KMS/HSM rotations (bring-your-own-HSM -> delegated KMS -> Vault) fail during certificate/key handoff or when control plane briefly cannot access the HSM. This PR introduces an orchestration layer and fallback wiring to make staged HSM-to-Vault promotions safe, observable, and rollback-friendly across Helm and Terraform upgrades. Summary: add a new controller (hsm-bridge-rotator) plus a small sealedsecret-fallback controller and Helm pre/post-upgrade hooks; extend the Terraform kms_alias module to support atomic alias promotion and dry-run mode; add idempotent smoke checks and audit events for each stage so ops can prove zero-downtime migration. Changes: 1) pkg/operator/hsmbridge: new controller and reconciliation loop that performs a 3-stage switch (prepare -> promote -> finalize) with explicit checkpoints and signatures for each stage. 2) pkg/operator/ss-fallback: a controller that watches sealedsecret failures and automatically creates a short-lived fallback secret (encrypted with transient envelope keys) when Vault is temporarily unreachable. 3) helm/redwood-private/templates/hooks: two new Helm hooks (pre-upgrade job that validates HSM connectivity and post-upgrade job that finalizes alias promotion). 4) terraform/modules/kms_alias: add 'atomic_promotion' boolean, 'dry_run' flag, and additional outputs for pre/post signatures. 5) charts/README and docs/installer/rotation.md: operational runbook, rollback playbook, and sample Linear tasks. 6) e2e/upgrade-scenarios: added a dry-run test for the promotion path (run under CI but gated by a change to e2e matrix). Why this is different: existing rotation helpers cover TLS cert renewal and simple key rotations; this PR coordinates an HSM-backed alias promotion across separate components, provides a sealed-secret fallback path to prevent data-plane downtime, and surfaces auditable signatures for compliance. Rollout plan: merged to main behind feature flag 'hsm_bridge_v1'. Operators can opt in via values.yaml: hsmBridge.enabled=true. Safety: pre-upgrade hook will fail the Helm upgrade if HSM connectivity checks or alias preconditions are not met. There is a manual override but it requires an explicit acknowledgement to avoid accidental data loss.
commits_summary: 5 commits: initial controller scaffold; add sealedsecret fallback controller; helm hooks and hook jobs; terraform kms_alias extension and tests; docs and runbook. Commit messages include implementation details and links to Linear tasks.
files_changed_summary: Key files changed: pkg/operator/hsmbridge/controller.go, pkg/operator/ssfallback/reconciler.go, helm/redwood-private/templates/pre-upgrade-job.yaml, helm/redwood-private/templates/post-upgrade-job.yaml, terraform/modules/kms_alias/main.tf, terraform/modules/kms_alias/outputs.tf, charts/values.schema.json, e2e/upgrade-scenarios/promotion_dryrun_test.go, docs/installer/rotation.md. Small changes to Makefile and CI matrix to add gated e2e job.
review_thread_summary: Reviewer Lena asked for clearer idempotency guarantees and explicit compensating actions for partial failures; author replied with a design note and added reconciliation checkpoints and compensating rollback functions. Arjun requested audit event enrichment (added correlation_id and stage_signature fields). Noah found a race in the Helm hook ordering; fixed by making the post-upgrade job wait on a configmap sentinel created by the controller. Final review approved after CI green and a manual test run was performed in staging.
ci_checks: CI pipeline: lint (pass), unit-tests (pass), integration (pass), e2e (flaky - initial run failed on a timing-sensitive e2e, rerun passed), security-scan (pass), terraform-validate (pass). The e2e flaky test was investigated and hardened by adding timeouts and a readiness probe to the fake-hsm test harness.
merge_summary: Merged via squash on 2024-05-20 after approvals. Merge commit includes a short changelog entry and reference to ENG-1428 and ENG-2021. Backport: no backport required; change gated by feature flag.
release_notes:
- Added hsm-bridge-rotator controller to orchestrate staged HSM->Vault promotions with audit signatures.
- Introduced sealedsecret fallback controller to prevent data-plane downtime when Vault is transiently unavailable.
- Helm hooks for pre-upgrade validation and post-upgrade finalization.
- Terraform kms_alias module supports atomic_promotion and dry_run for safer alias switchover.
Operational guidance in docs/installer/rotation.md.
post_merge_actions: 1) Enable feature flag in a single staging cluster and run the promotion dry-run documented in docs/installer/rotation.md. 2) Monitor audit events in console and ensure stage_signature correlation. 3) Schedule a runbook walkthrough with SRE and customer success for first production migrations.
notes_for_reversion: If a rollback is required: set hsmBridge.enabled=false and run helm rollback; the controller includes a reversible 'demote' path that will attempt to reattach aliases back to previous keystore. For catastrophic rollback, follow the manual playbook in docs/installer/rotation.md which includes steps to rekey sealed secrets and rehydrate ephemeral fallback keys.
testing_performed: Unit tests for controller logic (100% branch coverage for reconciliation paths), integration tests with a hardware-emulated HSM (softHSM) for connectivity, terraform unit tests (tfsec), and an e2e promotion dry-run against staging. Manual verification included an audit-event check showing stage signatures for prepare/promote/finalize.
